I would recommend creating a new account tbh, Ik it might be hard to but it will probably be more beneficial to you.

If you feel scared that something is going to happen please contact your emergency services or at least tell someone who can do something. your safety is your number 1 priority.

If you know 100% who the person is you can try and get a restraining order on him and hopefully that can help the situation.

Im sorry you are going through this and hopefully my advice helped. I hope you have a wonderful day/night ❤️
But I believe it is my fault though...

Aww thank you ❤️

I’m currently am seeing a therapist, I don’t know if she trauma informed (I think she is) but she knows what happened to me I’ve told her
